uv run --offline --frozen python -c "
import dataclasses, tempfile, pathlib
from tests._helpers import write_canonical_fixture
import yaml
from sloplab.models.suite import SuiteConfig
from sloplab.corpus.loader import discover_fixtures, FixtureError
from sloplab.mutations.materialize import materialize_suite
from sloplab.scoring.harness import build_cases, run_case
from sloplab.evaluators.base import get_evaluator
tmp = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
write_canonical_fixture(tmp/'c', 'v-000', fixture_id='canonical-v-000', title='T', report_class='valid')
suite = {'name':'s','base_seed':21,'corpus_root':str(tmp/'c'),'include_canonical_cases':True,'policies':{'valid':{'variants_per_fixture':1,'operators':['impact_inflation']}}}
sp = tmp/'suite.yaml'; sp.write_text(yaml.safe_dump(suite))
cfg = SuiteConfig.model_validate(yaml.safe_load(sp.read_text()))
canon,_ = discover_fixtures(tmp/'c'); materialize_suite(cfg, canon, tmp/'out')
cases = build_cases(tmp/'out'/'suite-index.jsonl', tmp/'c', tmp/'out')
m = next(c for c in cases if c.kind=='mutated')
(m.fixture_dir/'report.md').write_text('# X\n\nNope.\n')
(m.fixture_dir/'mutation-manifest.yaml').write_text('not: [valid\n')
legacy = dataclasses.replace(m, report=None)
try:
    run_case(get_evaluator('rules-baseline'), legacy)
    print('LEGACY SURVIVED (unexpected)')
except Exception as e:
    print('LEGACY FAILS as expected:', type(e).__name__)
print('SNAPSHOT OK:', run_case(get_evaluator('rules-baseline'), m).case_id)
"
note: Fixture başlığı kısa olduğundan FixtureError ile çöktü (beklenmedik değil, deneme hatası). Log tutulmadı; düzeltilmiş deneme ayrıca kayıtlı.
